description: ElizaOS plugin for GBLIN on Base — a gasless treasury rail for AI agents. Routes surplus agent capital into the MEV-protected GBLIN index (cbBTC/WETH/USDC, mint/redeem at NAV — managed crypto exposure, not a USDC substitute) and JIT-swaps back to USDC for x402 invoices. GBLIN is a discoverable ERC-8004 agent (#59286) on Base.
